label: The Failure of the Hero Guillotine: B

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Are you hurt?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: You seem quite surprised.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I suppose that's to be expected.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: You just saw the Grim Reaper incarnate. I strike fear in the hearts of Nikkes.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: It's natural to be afraid.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Just now, I defeated an Irregular that wanted to do you harm.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I have no intention of harming you, so don't worry.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Wow.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Wh-what did you just do?!

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: You just took down one of the Big O's lackeys with a glance.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: That was amazing!

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I-it was?

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Don't tell me...

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: You have the Lethal Eye?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Hmm? Lethal Eye? What's that?

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Hehe, there's no need to pretend.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: I already know that you have the One-Winged Dark Lord sealed within you.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: The One-Winged what?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I'm not entirely sure I follow you,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: but are you saying that you're not afraid of me?

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Afraid?

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Hehe...

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Hahahaha!

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Why would a member of the Association fear a friend?

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: You and I are on the same team.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Hmm.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: If you say so.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Anyway, I'll take you home, so follow me.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Wowee!

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: To think I get to meet the one holding the seal binding the One-Winged Dark Lord.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: This is a day for the history books!

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Are you going to stand there all day?

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Come inside.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I only promised to escort you to your house, not go inside...

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: I've been waiting for this day.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: The day when the one with the Lethal Eye would appear.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Fate has brought you and me together.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Who are we to deny it?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: You've been going on about all sorts of weird stuff for a while now.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I'm telling you, I'm not the one you're waiting for...

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Hehe, oh yes you are.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Whenever I spoke about the one possessing the Lethal Eye,

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: who sealed away the One-Winged Dark Lord and would save us from the Big O,

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: no one believed me.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: They said I was making it all up, and dismissed me entirely.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Some of them even hit me and bullied me.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: That's why they took me into the back alley earlier...

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: I don't want to talk about this anymore.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: The important thing is that you saved me today.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: You used your Lethal Eye to defeat those Organization lackeys!

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: All of my waiting, my suffering, has finally paid off.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: And since you saved me,

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: I can't send you off without thanking you in some way, can I?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: ... If that's what this is about, then

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I suppose I can come inside.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Hehe, I knew you'd understand. That's why you're my friend.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I have to ask...

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: have you been bullied this entire time?

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: ... Yeah, I have.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Everyone else is just jealous of my powers, that's all.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: I've been able to endure it, because it's all to avoid an even bigger disaster.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Hmm.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Can you do me a favor?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: For now, don't go talking about this to anyone.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Lethal Eye, the One-Winged Dark Lord, all that stuff.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Really? Are you sure?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I'm positive.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Hm.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Otherwise, the Big O might find out that

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: you know about them.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: So for now, only talk about this stuff with me.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I'll come here from time to time to listen.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: *Huff*... *Huff*...

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Has it already been a year since we met?

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: You've already surpassed me!

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: You really are amazing.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Hehe...

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Hahahaha!

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: It's only natural.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: After all, the One-Winged Dark Lord is sealed within this body of mine.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Who could possibly defeat me within the Virtual Combat Field?

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: I shall now pass my title onto you:

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: The Guardian of Balance, the one who observes the world.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Have you seen the Jarhead?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Have you not seen my spectacular performance?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Am I not worthy of bearing the title "Guardian of Balance"?

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Can you feel it?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Feel what?

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: The time has come.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: It is time for me to teach you my hidden technique: teleportation.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Come again?

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Watch and learn carefully. Here goes.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: El.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Telema.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Solus.
Chloe dashes forward at full speed.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: You're always teaching me new things.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: ... Guillotine.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: I could care less if you're muttering strange words.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: The fact that you've made a friend is already a step in the right direction.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: However...

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: I thought you said this was urgent.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: You called me all the way out here for this? I skipped a meeting for this!

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Go back and submit a report immediately!
Yo yo, everybody!
My name's Volume, and don't wear it out! Let me hear you scream!

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Wow, this really hits you in the feels.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Yeah, I can feel my blood pumping!

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Guillotine.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: If you're familiar with Volume at all, could you possibly persuade her to sign this document with her real name?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I've told you before.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I am the Reaper who leads Nikkes to death.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: So long as I possess the Lethal Eye, I cannot befriend other Nikkes.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: It is a most lonely fate indeed.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: If possible, I would have liked to fight alongside Absolute.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: They're said to be the strongest squad Elysion has ever formed.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: They are the guardians of this planet, like the mythological Cerberus guarding the gates of hell.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Especially that Blue-Eyed Little Devil.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Every time I see her, the One-Winged Dark Lord sealed within my eye goes into a fit!

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: *Sigh*... However, I am glad that I at least have you.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Guillotine.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Since you've grown accustomed to battles in the Virtual Combat Field,

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: I think it's time to start some new training methods.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Like what?

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Hehe, just you wait.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: I'll need a bit of time to prepare, so let's meet here same time tomorrow.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: All right! This is exciting, hehe.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Actually, I changed my mind.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Let's change it to two days from now.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: I forgot that my parents will be home tomorrow.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Are you ready?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Whew...

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Yes, everything is ready.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: All right, then I'll install the Soul Transfer Circle.
Chloe draws a magic circle with a red crayon.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Now, Guillotine, place your hand on the Soul Transfer Circle and close your eyes.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: When you do, your soul will travel to another world.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: A world under threat from the Big O is calling for you.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: For Guillotine, the hero!

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Damn those Big O scum! Is putting one world in danger not enough for them?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: All right, there's no time to waste.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Chloe! Send me to that other world immediately!

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: All right then.
Chloe opens her notebook,
which is crammed full of pages of her handwriting.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Ahem.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: A long time ago in a galaxy far, far away...

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: there was a fertile land where flowers perennially bloomed in their full glory.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: The people of the land spent their days breathing in the scent of these flowers carried by the warm breeze,

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: and they lived happily...

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Are you ready?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Send me back to the moment

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: where I join forces with the Blue-Eyed Little Devil and hunt down the monsters.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Hehe, to think I'll be able to fight side by side along with the other Nikkes.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: The adventures in this world are so much fun!

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Hehe, I'm glad you're enjoying it.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: It makes all the time it took to prepare it worth it.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: All right, Guillotine! Let's continue our adventure in this other world!

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Our exploits will one day be recorded in the Ice Dragon Saga!

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Shall we start?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Actually, I do have a question.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Why did you set up the Soul Transfer Circle outside today?

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Hehe, what a silly question.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Your soul has now reached the front of the Demon King's castle.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Soon, the final battle with the White Ice Dragon will take place.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: It's only fitting that we have a suitably large stage to match the grandeur of the situation.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Hehe...

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Hahahaha!

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I hadn't thought that far ahead.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: You're as perspicacious as ever, Chloe.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Come to think of it, Guillotine.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Before we start the adventure, there's something you should know.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Not just anyone can enter the Demon King's castle.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: The entrance only opens to those with the courage to move forward.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: Keep that in mind.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Only those with the courage to move forward.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I'll remember that.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: All right, let's begin the adventure!
*Beep beep beep*

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Hmm? Is that Ingrid?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Sorry, but I've got to take this call.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: ... I'm supposed to go on an adventure, I'm busy.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Ugh. Fine.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Hmm? There's an Irregular nearby?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Where?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Fine. I'll be right over.

lines.speaker: chloe
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Chloe, stay somewhere safe.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: The adventure will have to wait.

lines.speaker: newsanchor
lines.text: Onto our next story.

lines.speaker: newsanchor
lines.text: A mass shooting took place in the city last night, around 9 PM.

lines.speaker: newsanchor
lines.text: Current reports state that 8 citizens were killed, and more than 20 seriously injured.

lines.speaker: newsanchor
lines.text: Citizens have gathered at the scene to voice their anger.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Guillotine.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Chloe is currently in a coma.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: She went outside saying she left her notebook, the Ice Dragon Sage, she called it,

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: and got into an accident.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: I'm sorry...

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: to have to have to tell you this.
